Container.Name: cinemask
Container.Overview: Self-hosted family media manager for Plex and Jellyfin households. Requests and downloads like Overseerr, Sonarr and Radarr, plus collections, lists, a calendar, books and audiobooks (Audiobookshelf, Shelfmark), with real user accounts, single sign-on, API keys, Home Assistant support and automatic backups.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database, settings, instance key and local backups

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Where your download clients save files. Keep it on the same share as Media so imports can hardlink.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your library: movies, tv, youtube, audiobooks and books folders live here.

Config.Name: Remote backups (optional)
Config.Description: Optional second share for backup copies. Set Settings, Backups, Remote copy to folder /remote-backups.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permissions for imported media, so Plex, Jellyfin and Audiobookshelf can read it. /config stays private either way.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone, used for backup schedules and the calendar

Config.Name: Trust reverse proxy
Config.Description: Set to true only when the app is behind a reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik)
